query:
-- Nettoyer plant_molecules orphelines
DELETE pm FROM plant_molecules pm 
LEFT JOIN molecules m ON pm.molecule_id = m.id 
WHERE m.id IS NULL;

-- Nettoyer molecule_origins orphelines
DELETE mo FROM molecule_origins mo 
LEFT JOIN molecules m ON mo.molecule_id = m.id 
WHERE m.id IS NULL;

-- Nettoyer ghost_variety_plant_links orphelines (plantes supprimées)
DELETE gvpl FROM ghost_variety_plant_links gvpl 
LEFT JOIN plants p ON gvpl.plant_id = p.id 
WHERE p.id IS NULL;
